LESSON: SIGN READING 3.2.2 COMPREHENSION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.2: Sign Reading 3.2.2 Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 3.2.2 Comprehension, part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to understand what we sign read?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 3.2.2 Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital literacy: interaction with digital devices is enhanced as the learner sign reads simple digital texts.

Creativity and imagination as the learner makes predictions about a story.

Values:
● Unity: Cooperation as the learner collaborates with others in group activities.

● Respect: Acceptance as the learner appreciates diverse opinions of others during group activities.

39

Link to Pertinent Contemporary Issues:

Education for Sustainable Development: Disaster Risk Reduction is enhanced as the learner becomes aware of safety in the use of the different modes of

transport.

Link to other Learning areas:

This is able to relate the skill of sign reading comprehension to all other learning areas.

Suggested Learning Resources

Adapted course book, Chart, class readers, course books, flash cards, recording devices e.g tablets, mobile phone, dictionary, magazine, newspaper,

internet, signed audio-visual recordings
